handoff.purpose: Implements the agentic tool-calling loop (_run_agentic) and the context-window eviction helper (_forced_report), including schema rescue for write tasks.

symbols.name: _run_agentic
symbols.note: Main agent loop; calls native_chat, _dispatch, _schema_rescue, _forced_report, coerce_report, extract_json.

symbols.name: _forced_report
symbols.note: Evicts conversation to minimal form and makes one final report call; body continues in next chunk.

claims.text: do NOT write; propose edits in your report
claims.why: The code sets action to this string when writable is False.

claims.text: PRE-FLIGHT: never make a call we know the server will head-truncate.
claims.why: Lines 621-624 check if estimated tokens exceed window and return blocked_report if so.

claims.text: count_tokens is cl100k, which OVER-counts qwen tokens, so this refuses a bit early (honest escalation) rather than letting the system prompt be silently eaten.
claims.why: Comment describes the behavior; code uses count_tokens and compares to window.

claims.text: Same downstream semantics as a provider failure.
claims.why: The chunk does not define 'provider failure' semantics.

claims.text: MID-LOOP EVICTION: tool results grow the history. Before every round after the first, if the full conversation would overflow, do NOT send it (the server would head-truncate the system prompt). Evict to a minimal form and force the report instead.
claims.why: Lines 632-635 check grown tokens against window and call _forced_report if overflow.

claims.text: THE EXPENSIVE FAILURE, CAUGHT. A write task that stops calling tools without having written anything is almost never 'done' -- it is a model that decided correctly and then narrated the decision in prose instead of emitting it.
claims.why: Lines 643-644 check `not calls and writable and not changed` and trigger schema rescue.

claims.text: MEASURED 2026-07-29: qwen2.5-coder 7b/14b and devstral emit 0% structured tool_calls on agent-shaped tasks and 100% when the shape is constrained at the sampler. So ask once more, with the shape compelled, before believing 'done'.
claims.why: Measurement data is not in the chunk; the code does implement the described rescue logic.

claims.text: Gated on ``writable and not changed`` on purpose: models that emit calls natively (qwen3.6 scored 100%) reach here only when genuinely finished, and pay nothing.
claims.why: The condition on line 643 matches the guard described.

claims.text: FAIL LOUD, NEVER EMPTY. A write task that wrote nothing, whose constrained re-ask could not even be delivered (or came back as something other than the shape it was forced into), is not a finished turn.
claims.why: Lines 656-662 return blocked_report when rescue.kind != RESCUE_FINISHED and calls empty.

claims.text: Reading the model's prose as a report here is precisely how 'unreachable bench' and 'model chose finish' became the same observable outcome.
claims.why: Historical context not present in chunk.

claims.text: Evict the conversation to a minimal form and make ONE final report call.
claims.why: Docstring of _forced_report states this; code continues in next chunk but the claim is about intent.

claims.text: keep only the system prompt, the original objective, the LAST tool result, and a report-now instruction -- head-truncating the tool result ourselves
claims.why: The implementation of _forced_report is not fully present; body continues in next chunk.
